title: Healthcare Operations
subtitle: Earn trust through a narrow design-partner path under procurement and compliance pressure.
description: A painful healthcare workflow has real value, but users, champions, buyers, security, privacy, procurement, lenders, and investors operate on different timelines. Prove a narrow operational outcome without accepting obligations the startup cannot support or treating an issued invoice as guaranteed cash.
learningObjectives: Map user, champion, buyer, and compliance owner
Use contractual boundaries to manage risk
Finance the company without assuming capital or collections are available

problems.title: Access depends on trust the founder has not earned
problems.summary: Workflow users cannot independently approve a pilot.
hypotheses: An advisor can provide credible introductions
A non-clinical workflow avoids the access barrier
The initial institution is the wrong segment

problems.title: The data and regulatory boundary is undefined
problems.summary: A prototype could create obligations the startup cannot support.
hypotheses: A manual process can avoid storing sensitive data

problems.title: Clinical value has no mapped economic buyer
problems.summary: User enthusiasm is disconnected from budget and procurement timing.
hypotheses: IT can sponsor a risk-reduction case
The labor saving is below the purchasing threshold

problems.title: The sales cycle is longer than personal runway
problems.summary: The founder needs learning-compatible income while navigating procurement.
hypotheses: A workflow audit can fund discovery
A smaller provider can move faster
